nodes.description: External function createClone(address target) that deploys a minimal proxy (EIP-1167 clone) via inline assembly and returns the created address.
Input parameter target: address of the implementation contract to be cloned.
Local bytes20 targetBytes holding the ABI-padded address of target for embedding in the clone bytecode.
Named return variable result that receives the address of the newly deployed clone from the assembly create call.
Inline assembly block that writes the clone bytecode to memory and executes create(0, clone, 0x37), deploying arbitrary proxy code and returning the address.

edges.reason: The address parameter target is supplied by the caller and consumed by the createClone function body.
target is cast with bytes20(target) and stored into the local variable targetBytes.
Execution of createClone enters the inline assembly block that performs the deployment.
targetBytes is mstore'd into the clone bytecode buffer at offset 0x14 inside the assembly block.
The address returned by the assembly create call is assigned to the named return variable result.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter target is only meaningful as the caller-supplied argument of the createClone function, so it is normalized into that core function node.
The temporary targetBytes exists solely to feed the clone bytecode produced inside the unsafe assembly create operation.
The return variable result only carries the outcome of createClone back to its caller, so it is normalized into the core function node.
